title: Phul Belochus
summary: Raleigh names Phul Belochus in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Phul Belochus, who with Arbaces wrested Babylon from Sardanapalus, and took a thousand talents of Menahem. Raleigh makes Teglath his sonne. He is not Tiglath-Pileser III, and not Belochus Priscus. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.
